days.label: Monday
days.title: A soft landing.
days.description: Clear clues, familiar words, and plenty of places to begin.

days.label: Tuesday
days.title: A little room to wander.
days.description: An inviting theme, with a few more turns along the way.

days.label: Wednesday
days.title: Just enough to get lost.
days.description: Playful clues, satisfying connections, and a little resistance.

days.label: Thursday
days.title: Expect a change of rules.
days.description: An inventive theme. Perhaps a rebus, a twist, or a different way to read the grid.

days.label: Friday
days.title: Follow the long way round.
days.description: A themeless puzzle, expressive long answers, and more oblique clues.

days.label: Saturday
days.title: Something to sit with.
days.description: The most demanding clues. Give the connections time to arrive.

days.label: Sunday
days.title: Make an afternoon of it.
days.description: A larger themed grid with a midweek feel. More room, rather than the hardest clues.
